method.scope: all embedded-text blocks inside the repository ASCE body-content y-band
method.candidate_rule: existing ASCE section regex applied to normalized block text
method.collision_definition: same numeric locator recognized from more than one source block
method.typography_observation: first source span font family/style and size retained from PyMuPDF block dictionaries
method.interpretation_boundary: typography is measured evidence for declaration/source-role discrimination; it is not itself an authority classification

finding: The measured collision family is not safely resolvable from numeric locator text alone. Regular numeric-leading prose/table/graph blocks and bold-italic source-role material can collide with bold provision declarations. The existing PdfBlock line/span model already carries the typography needed for a bounded declaration-context/source-role discriminator.
next_gate: Use preserved PdfLine/PdfSpan typography to classify ASCE declaration candidates conservatively before section promotion, with representative exact-source regression cases for bold provision declarations, regular numeric-leading references/data, and bold-italic role-distinct material. Re-run whole-document replay and require the targeted collision families to resolve without promoting ambiguous material.
